tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: United States Capitol Historical Society (in this chapter, the “corporation”) is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Place of Incorporation.—
tree.text: The corporation is declared to be incorporated in the District of Columbia.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the corporation has perpetual existence.
